response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
